subject.title: fix(ui): prevent unsafe custodian nudge answers

question: Should this maintainer-labeled Custodian safety change be adopted after the branch is rebased and the contributor supplies live hosted-wizard proof, or should the team accept the mocked-browser contract as sufficient for this UI-only path?
rationale: The remaining gate is evidence sufficiency for a protected maintainer-handled PR rather than a mechanical code repair; the live setup attempted by the author did not reach the relevant wizard state.

options.title: Require live wizard proof
options.body: Rebase the branch and provide a redacted live hosted-wizard transcript or terminal capture proving the sensitive and non-card step guards before merge.

options.title: Accept deterministic-browser proof
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the existing Chromium-plus-Gateway-contract coverage if reproducing a live hosted wizard remains blocked by unrelated runtime infrastructure.

recommendation.title: Require live wizard proof
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch and provide a redacted live hosted-wizard transcript or terminal capture proving the sensitive and non-card step guards before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The author owns the current branch and documented the live-environment blocker and available proof.
